text:
Olivia: quick sync  we need a focused newsletter + upgrade playbook tied to the benchmark webinar next Thurs. primary goals: live regs, nudge trial-to-upgrade, and capture demo requests for high-value accounts. keep it light and measurable.
Marcus: propose a 3-email invite + 2-email post-event upgrade path: invite (reg), reminder (social proof + upgrade benefit), day-of (calendar add + quick benefit bullets). post-event: 1) replay + short upgrade pitch, 2) targeted upgrade offer for trialers with CTA Book Demo.
Hannah: segmentation: 1) active trialers, 2) high-usage free accounts, 3) enterprise/dedicated. different hooks: trialers -> 'Resume where you left off', high-usage -> 'See how to lower per-token cost', enterprise -> 'SLA & priority access'.
Devon: sample SQLs for DF pulls:
```
-- active trialers
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE trial_active = true
  AND last_active > now() - interval '30 days'
  AND unsubscribed = false;
-- high-usage free accounts
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE plan = 'free'
  AND monthly_token_usage > 10000
  AND last_active > now() - interval '90 days'
  AND unsubscribed = false;
-- enterprise/dedicated
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE dedicated_customer = true
  AND account_health IN ('good','needs_attention')
  AND unsubscribed = false;
```
Olivia: suppression lists: previous_webinar.no_emails, bounced_90d, partner_contacts, and hard_bounces. also exclude users flagged do_not_market = true.
Marcus: subject & preheader plan: keep subjects under 60 chars. example subjects:
- Trialers: "Resume your trial + see benchmark results"
- High-usage: "Lower your inference cost by 30% (real numbers)"
- Enterprise: "Priority access: benchmark walkthrough + SLA notes"
Preheaders: "Join live + get the report" vs "Get the numbers + upgrade path". A/B test subject vs preheader for trialers only.
Hannah: CTA split: 70% direct reg, 30% blog+reg. For trialers, another split: 60% direct resume session (deep link to console), 40% webinar reg. Track which drives more upgrades.
Devon: analytics tags: add utm_campaign=benchmark_upgrade_q1, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. fire events: nl_open, nl_click, nl_register, trial_resume, upgrade_request. tag registrants with source=newsletter_benchmark for lead-scoring.
Olivia: upgrade offer mechanic: post-event email to trialers with a short, time-limited CTA for a 14-day Dedicated trial credit or waived setup for those who request a demo within 7 days. include T&Cs link. Sales to be notified via AE queue for any upgrade_request tags.
Marcus: deliverability ops: microbatch ramp 5% -> 25% -> 80% -> 100% over 18h. seed list of 120. monitor spam complaints threshold 0.05% to pause. also throttle slices with <1% open after 3h.
Hannah: copy notes: one-sentence opener, one metric + one customer quote in email 2, short bullets for upgrade benefits, and a bold single CTA. for trialers include a resume deep link: https://console.redwood.ai/resume?token={user_token} (use tokenized links).
Devon: QA checklist: render (Gmail, Outlook, iOS), link validation, token link fallbacks (if token invalid show login page), calendar .ics for day-of, accessible alt text, text-only fallback. deliver final assets to deliverability 24h before send.
Olivia: timeline: Hannah drafts copy by Tue noon, Marcus reviews Tue EOD, DF pulls Wed night, QA Thu, ramp Fri NA/EMEA, APAC Mon local. post-event upgrade push Mon after webinar.
Marcus: sales coordination: AE brief doc with dedicated list + dynamic snippet in email "Dedicated customers: priority demo slot" so AEs can follow up. include a small CSV export for AEs with upgrade_score > 0.7.
Hannah: testing: 1) subject A/B for trialers, 2) CTA destination test (resume vs reg), 3) from-name test (Redwood vs Redwood Inference) only on high-usage cohort to minimize risk.
PreviewBot: staging preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/newsletter/1805555555 (staging). mobile snapshot looks clean.
Devon: tracking & dashboard: set dashboards for reg rate by segment, trial_resume rate, demo bookings, and upgrade conversions. attribute upgrades to newsletter if upgrade_request tag appears within 14 days.
Olivia: locking plan. Marcus please post final segment counts when DF completes so we can size the AE queue. Hannah, please keep subject length <60 and preheader <120.
Marcus: will run DF now and post counts. estimate ~8k trialers, ~14k high-usage free, ~600 dedicated.
Hannah: drafting copy now. will share in thread for review.
PreviewBot: job queued for staging preview (job 5120).
